'''2009 Worlds Team Tournament Shane - Punklord DS Combat Readiness''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Shane - Punklord]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Team Tournament).

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Combat Readiness]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
